Acme moves to a weekly release cycle

By a staff writer, Example City

Acme, a fictional maker of garden tools, said on Monday that it will ship weekly updates to its scheduling app starting next quarter, replacing the monthly cycle it has used since launch.

“We ship weekly now because our customers asked us to,” the company’s chief executive told reporters at the briefing. “Small changes are easier to test — and easier to undo.”

Analysts at a fictional research firm estimated that growth[3] in the app’s subscriber base reached 14 percent last year, outpacing the wider market.

The company also confirmed that the relationship weekly report, an internal summary sent to partners, will move to a fortnightly schedule.

Shares in the company were unchanged by the end of trading.
